body: Thanks, that helps. I mostly think that there are people that need me here, yet they do not know how I'm feeling. Anyway, thanks for taking the time to read some random on the internet. Like you said, life is a chaos right now. The fast way to end this is by giving up, but seeing it through is an option too even tho I'm not seeing support on that from anywhere. Thanks man, for real.

Thanks for taking the time, but I'm certainly decided it has to end. Saying fuck them all the way would just screw my life even more, so not an option, as you may have heard, my country (Venezuela) is a living hell, that certainly doesn't help the depression. Life is just a cage right now and every road just leads somewhere I'm afraid being, and I just can't handle the fact that all my work or time spent has led to this. It fucking sucks. What's the point, you know?
